workouts.title: Strict Handstand Push-Ups
workouts.description:
3 Sets:
3-12 Strict Handstand Push-Ups (or Box Pike HSPU)
12-15 Dumbbell Z-Press
Rest 2:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- If you need to work on your handstand push-up strength choose the box pike handstand push-up. DO NOT USE ABMAT TODAY! I want you to work at full ROM!

workouts.title: Tempo Pause Front Squat
workouts.description:
Tempo Pause Front Squat
3x3 @ 12x1 Tempo / RPE 7
Rest 2:00-3:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- "12x1" means that you will take :01 to descend, :02 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.
- This is a deload week. Build to a weight to use for all three sets that is moderate, but you could still do about three more reps with if you wanted to on each set.
- Keep the pause at full depth. Stand straight up from the bottom of each rep with no bounce.

Aim for a weight that allows each set to be unbroken.
- Walk with control, don't sprint!
